senses.en_definition: Also; too; likewise, indicating an addition or similarity to what has already been mentioned.
Still; nevertheless; after all, indicating that a situation persists or an outcome occurs despite difficulties or expectations.

messages.en: Yana and I are going to the movies now. Wanna come?
I wanna come too! Hang on a sec, let me grab my wallet.

senses.en_definition: Honest, sincere, and straightforward in one's words and actions.

collocations.en: be truthful in what one says

senses.en_definition: A customary marriage payment made by the groom to the bride's parents, chiefly in the phrase wang jujur.

messages.en: Be honest with me—have you read that message or not?
I have. Sorry, I wasn't sure how to reply earlier, so I held off.
How much is it altogether? I wanna pay my share.
It's RM60 altogether. There are three of us, so it's just RM20 each.

senses.en_definition: To meet, encounter, or go to see someone.
To find or discover someone or something.

messages.en: Can we meet at the mamak place tomorrow at two?
Sure. I finish work at one, then I'll head straight over.
